Add an Interactive Overview MiniMap (add_minimap)

Source: R/controls.R
add_minimap.Rd

Drop-in GPU/Canvas equivalent of leaflet::addMiniMap(). Adds a synchronized inset overview map with an interactive aiming rectangle showing the current viewport extent and click-to-pan navigation.

Usage

add_minimap(
  map,
  position = "bottomright",
  width = 150,
  height = 150,
  zoomLevelOffset = -5,
  toggleDisplay = TRUE,
  aimingRectOptions = list(color = "#ff7800", weight = 2),
  order = 80,
  ...
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

position

Anchor position in the 9-zone layout grid (default "bottomright").

width, height

MiniMap dimensions in pixels (default 150).

zoomLevelOffset

Numeric zoom offset relative to the main map (default -5).

toggleDisplay

Logical; whether to show a collapse/expand button on the MiniMap (default TRUE).

aimingRectOptions

Optional styling list for the viewport aiming rectangle.

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 80).

...

Additional arguments kept for leaflet::addMiniMap() compatibility.

Value

Updated glmap widget or glmap_proxy.
